title: Fix Kit Wires Force Graph on VFS Unfold
description: When unfolding in kit app in vfs, the force graph in wires sometimes doesnt update properly and the nodes jump out of screen.
summary: Fixed kit wires force graph jumping off screen when unfolding VFS branches. Topology updates now merge settled node positions and camera instead of resetting to grid layout; new nodes spawn near their parent. Unified async VFS child loading so wires topology always waits for the same in-flight branch load. Live force RAF restarts when node ids change.
